event.name: An Abandoned Forge
event.text: The coals are still warm. A smith could make something better here.

options.text: A common or uncommon piece of yours becomes one of the next rarity, of its kind.

event.text: A grinning stranger with a pair of bone dice. "Double or nothing?"

event.text: Practice dummies, a rack of blunted weapons, and a sergeant with a whistle.

options.text: Three members each learn an ability or train one.

event.name: An Empty Camp
event.text: Someone left in a hurry: the fire is still burning, the bedrolls still laid out.

options.text: A campfire: rest, focus, raise or train.

options.text: A potion, a tonic or a phoenix feather, and 20 gold.
